methods.label: Balance unit profit and increased sales
methods.explanation: Let the price reduction be \(x\) yuan. Then \((60-x-40)(100+10x)=2160\), which simplifies to \(x^2-10x+16=0\), giving \(x=2\) or \(8\). To give customers greater savings, choose the larger price reduction, 8.
